patch_description: Add a targeted greedy hill-climb stage that directly manipulates the distance pairs that matter: the pair realizing the current minimum distance (push them apart along their separation direction) and the pair realizing the maximum distance (pull them toward each other), plus a coordinated triple move doing both simultaneously. Single-coordinate or smooth-gradient polishes often stall on plateaus because improving the ratio requires coordinated displacement of both endpoints. This stage uses exact ratio evaluation with an accept/reject shrinking step, is scale-invariant (re-normalizes diameter to 1), and is cheap (91 pairs). It is appended after Stage 5 so it can only improve the result.
